mapper.select: select id, stat_date as statDate, creator_id as creatorId, content_count as contentCount, view_count as viewCount, like_count as likeCount, favorite_count as favoriteCount, signup_count as signupCount, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from creator_metric_daily where creator_id = #{creatorId} order by stat_date desc, id desc limit 1
